title: Exact-span and scan-quality matches leave insufficient Yale bifolio support for the proposed production-marker test
statement: A support-only audit reconciles 50 represented physical pairs in the pinned ZL map with the archived EVT bifolio inventory. Voyager passed registration for 176 of 176 candidate sides and Yale for 143 of 181. The Yale failures comprised 13 rectos and 25 versos, with 34 failures for the box-center hull criterion and four for the p90 registration error. With both faces retained, the prospective Yale sample has 19 mate pairs, 13 with an exact-span within-quire nonmate. Matching both leaves' orientation-specific registration error tiers leaves seven mates across six quires. Six have a control disjoint from the mate pair, across five quires. The stricter archival sensitivity of at least 20 valid crops per side gives the same seven informative mates. Under the same error-tier design Voyager has 21 of 40 mates with controls across nine quires, or 19 across seven quires with disjoint controls. Requiring both captures and both error-tier matches on the same leaves leaves one informative mate in one quire. The primary Yale design falls below its frozen eight-quire support floor, so the normalized stroke-width marker was specified and no marker contrast was scored.
check: Build a new registration or annotation set for the currently excluded Yale word regions, with priorities fixed by scan availability before reading any marker values. Track recto and verso coverage, numbered foldout panels and the archival exclusions separately. Preserve the physical mate map and same-quire exact positive folio span; maintain independent capture-quality matching. Freeze a calibration for one normalized stroke-width measurement using known-width clean and degraded line shapes outside the manuscript. Proceed to the quire-weighted comparison only with at least eight informative Yale quires and report the disjoint-control sensitivity.
scope_notes: The 58 EVT relationships include missing members. All 50 pairs represented by two leaves in the pinned canonical map occur in the archived inventory. The labels bA3 and bA5 differ for the f3 and f6 pair between the two metadata files. The quire-one description gives f3 and f6 as a single sheet.

Distance is the absolute difference in written folio numbers on the retained leaves, not production order. Recto and verso must each contribute a registered labelled face in the primary design. The archive's nominal extraction does not admit numbered foldout-panel identifiers. The hull records anonymous word-box center coverage, so margins, seams, folds and occluded regions have unknown marker coverage.

The quality tier is below-or-equal versus above each scan's median passing held-out p90 registration error, with orientation retained. An unordered pair of tier profiles makes paired matching invariant to the order in which leaves are named. Source-internal quality bins and common availability are compared without inspecting production feature values.

All exact-span nonmates are enumerated before looking at a marker. Some controls share one leaf with a mate pair and the disjoint-control analysis separately excludes these. The eight-quire support rule was fixed before counting for the primary Yale design. The two sources image the same manuscript. These counts concern test feasibility and are not measured effects.

frozen_design.physical_controls: nonmate leaves in the same quire at exactly the same absolute folio-number distance
frozen_design.primary_coverage: both recto and verso have passing registered features
frozen_design.quality_match: same unordered pair of orientation-specific p90 error tiers, split at the median held-out registration p90 among all passing page sides within that scan source
sensitivities: At least one accepted side per leaf, without quality-tier matching
Both accepted sides per leaf, without quality-tier matching
Primary requirements after taking the common Yale and Voyager leaf set
frozen_design.marker_if_supported: Normalized stroke width: per page-side median of twice the distance-to-background radius on the ink medial axis divided by the height of its connected ink component. Estimate in stable anonymous glyph boxes, with thresholds frozen on independent clean and degraded line drawings before evaluating mate contrasts.
frozen_design.stop_rule: Report coverage and support only if strict Yale support has fewer than eight informative quires. Never select a marker by its observed contrast.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12, standard library. Place archived results CSV files and quire descriptions next to the script and use the pinned ZL file identified in the audit.
